name: Inspect a server component
description: Selecting a hardware system updates its explainer and selection index.
steps: Click the Memory modules item in the Component Index
expected: Part Inspector displays Memory modules, its role and explanatory details, and the Memory modules index item is selected.

name: Adjust server decomposition
description: The model should separate and reassemble in response to its range control.
expected: The percentage changes to 100% then 0%, and the 3D server parts move apart and reassemble.

name: Reset the model
description: Reset returns the prototype to a known usable starting state.
steps: On mobile select Power supplies from the horizontal index
expected: Selected part returns to Processors and decomposition returns to 43%; mobile layout remains usable.

name: Read navigation help and browse components
description: Navigation remains accessible without a login.
steps: Click the help icon above the model
Read the instructions then close them
Click Next component in the inspector
expected: Instructions open and close; Next component updates the inspector to the following component.
